create_daytona_environment: create a DaytonaEnvironment instance with a Docker image, task ID, and persistent filesystem enabled
run_bash_command_sandbox: run a bash command string inside a Daytona cloud sandbox with a configurable timeout
upload_files_bulk_sandbox: bulk upload multiple files from host to a Daytona sandbox using a single HTTP call
download_files_hermes_dir: download the .hermes directory from a Daytona sandbox as a tar archive
cleanup_daytona_sandbox: cleanup a DaytonaEnvironment by syncing files back and stopping or deleting the sandbox
